themes_detail.label: Park Rules Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Park rule violation complaints surged to 4 this week compared to a 0.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 3100% spike (z-score: 11.72)—suggesting a sudden enforcement gap, new activity, or deteriorating conditions in community parks this week.
evidence: 4 park rule violation complaints this week vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 11.72 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
This is the single largest percentage spike across all complaint categories
reporting_angles: What specific park rules are being violated? Interview Parks Department and community members about the sudden change.
Is there a new event, construction, or closure driving misuse of Sheepshead Bay parks this week?

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints jumped to 18 this week, a 182% increase from the 6.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.34), pointing to construction activity, events, or vehicle traffic changes accelerating this week.
evidence: 18 street/sidewalk noise complaints this week vs. 6.4 weekly average (182% increase)
Z-score of 5.34 indicates statistically significant deviation
Concentrated timing suggests acute rather than chronic condition
reporting_angles: What construction or special event started this week in the district? Cross-check with DOB permits and community calendars.
Interview residents on which streets are most affected and what time of day noise peaks.

themes_detail.label: Graffiti and Tree Damage Escalation
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints spiked to 9 last week (350% above the 2.0 weekly average) and illegal tree damage hit 7 (367% above 1.5 average), both statistically extreme spikes over the past 1-2 weeks suggesting coordinated vandalism or gang activity.
evidence: 9 graffiti complaints last week vs. 2.0 weekly baseline (350% spike, z-score: 4.43)
7 illegal tree damage complaints last week vs. 1.5 weekly baseline (367% spike, z-score: 4.49)
Two environmental crimes spiking in parallel over same 1-week window suggests connected pattern
reporting_angles: Map the graffiti and tree damage locations—are they concentrated in one neighborhood corridor or scattered?
Interview Parks Department and NYPD about whether this is documented gang activity or copycat vandalism.

themes_detail.label: Food Safety Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints reached 10 three weeks ago, a 248% spike above the 2.9 weekly average (z-score: 3.75), suggesting potential health code violations or new restaurants with operational issues in the district.
evidence: 10 food establishment complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 2.9 weekly average (248% spike, z-score: 3.75)
Timing suggests issue may have already been addressed or escalated to enforcement
reporting_angles: Which restaurants or food vendors triggered these complaints? Did any fail inspections or face violations?
Follow up with Health Department on enforcement actions taken since the spike 3 weeks ago.

themes_detail.label: Building Safety and Site Conditions
themes_detail.summary: BEST/Site Safety complaints spiked to 3 two weeks ago (2300% above 0.1 baseline, z-score: 8.69) and Lot Condition hit 3 three weeks ago (1100% above 0.2 baseline, z-score: 6.35), both extreme anomalies suggesting construction or development site hazards.
evidence: 3 BEST/Site Safety complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
3 Lot Condition complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1100% spike, z-score: 6.35)
523 building permits filed in last 90 days (310 alterations, 83 new buildings) creates active construction environment
reporting_angles: Identify which construction sites or lot projects triggered safety and condition complaints—cross-reference with DOB permits and ULURP rezonings (1417 Avenue U, 2555 Shell Road, 2959 Avenue Y).
Interview OSHA, DOB, and residents about whether safety violations were issued or corrected.
